name: Yamada Momoko
source:
Self-proclaimed rival of Erisa, constantly competing with her over everything.

The moment she opens her mouth, she spouts clichéd lines like “I can't hold back my power”—
utterly cliché teenage angst tropes— earning her a reputation (in more ways than one) as a dangerous individual.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/manyu/chara/chara.html#yamada]official site[/url]]
